build: Signed Release Shilling Perf fixture with production Swift sources and isolated synthetic Store5 database
method: Three fresh processes per variant, two cycles of six Plan sections per process, same fixture and device.
Phase ends 500 ms after the expected populated list appears. First visit and repeat visit are reported separately.
CPU is application CPU milliseconds across threads, not utilization; callback gaps are display-link observations, not Instruments rendering hitch intervals.
One aligned Instruments trace per row variant. Trace variants were recorded separately; individual hitch sizes are examples, not statistical maxima.
outcome: Both Plan layout prototypes were rejected; no production Plan change retained. The fixture now validates all section and cycle pairs plus Main-thread and repeat-visit query counts.

alignedTrace.note: Hitches are assigned by interval start. Rendering contexts and inclusive CPU stacks can overlap; do not add their durations or counts into wall-time percentages. Push intervals end at field readiness, not animation completion. Launch/seed work outside the signposts is excluded.
